File:Islamic Congregational Prayer with Physical Distancing during the Covid-19 Pandemic.jpg

photo.fileTitle: File:Islamic Congregational Prayer with Physical Distancing during the Covid-19 Pandemic.jpg
photo.caption: Muslims in Indonesia pray in congregation while imposing to strict physical-distancing protocols during the COVID-19 pandemic. During the pandemic, Mosques in Indonesia has also removed the indoor rugs and has ordered worshipers to bring their own personal prayer rugs to prevent the spreading of the virus. Some mosques which are located in the most infected regions even are ordered to be closed for worship
photo.description: Islamic Prayer during the COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia. Physical distancing imposed and mandatory for worshipers to wear face masks. The rug of the mosque is also removed and worshipers must bring their own personal rugs for prayer

photo.caption: Swine flu cases per week in the United Kingdom in 2009; schools typically close for summer in mid-July and re-open in early September.
photo.description: Swineflu cases in the UK (HPA modelling).
